description: For site visit, this checklist records planned observations, coordination topics, quality checkpoints, progress claims, and unresolved prior items. Its supporting evidence includes field notes, representative photos, measurements, discussion record, and referenced drawing details.

blocks.guidance: Link this site visit record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Site Visit Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture visit purpose, attendees, zones observed, work in progress, current documents, weather, and access limitations for this site visit.
blocks.label: Site Visit Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify visit purpose, attendees, zones observed, work in progress, current documents, weather, and access limitations for this site visit record.
sections.title: Checkpoint Reference

blocks.guidance: For site visit, record planned observations, coordination topics, quality checkpoints, progress claims, and unresolved prior items.
blocks.label: Site Visit Required Inputs

blocks.guidance: Verify the site visit condition before marking.
items: Define walking route, representative sampling, excluded rooms, and observation duration
Compare visible progress to milestone forecast, look-ahead sequence, and reported percent complete
Record field conversations by participant without converting discussion into contract direction
Distinguish observation memo, potential nonconformance, design question, and photographic context
Note visitor orientation, personal protective equipment, escort, and access interruption
Schedule targeted revisit for inaccessible work, changing conditions, mockup, or correction verification
blocks.label: Site Visit Verification Points

blocks.guidance: Pair each site visit result with a finding.
blocks.label: Site Visit Checkpoint Result

blocks.guidance: Immediately report observed imminent hazards; distinguish observation from exhaustive inspection or direction. Route unresolved site visit work for review.
blocks.label: Site Visit Applicable Review Boundary

sections.guidance: For site visit, capture planned observations, coordination topics, quality checkpoints, progress claims, and unresolved prior items.
sections.title: Conditions to Verify

blocks.guidance: For site visit, record field notes, representative photos, measurements, discussion record, and referenced drawing details.
blocks.label: Site Visit Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.guidance: Cite every site visit evidence source.
blocks.label: Site Visit Evidence Sources

blocks.guidance: Reconcile unchecked site visit items before release.
items: Correct checklist version and applicability are confirmed
Prerequisite documents and access are available
Each item is marked verified, not applicable, or exception
Exceptions name an owner and target correction date
Final release is within the reviewer's authority
blocks.label: Site Visit Repeatable Checklist

blocks.guidance: State site visit limits, assumptions, and access gaps.
blocks.label: Site Visit Limitations and Interpretation

sections.guidance: Support site visit findings with field notes, representative photos, measurements, discussion record, and referenced drawing details.
sections.title: Verification Finding Record

subtitle: Site Visit Checklist: construction site visit observation and follow-up using visit purpose, planned observations, and field notes.
title: Site Visit Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during construction site visit observation and follow-up when the site visit record must identify visit purpose, attendees, zones observed, work in progress, current documents, weather, and access limitations. Complete the applicable handoff for observation distribution, responsible-party response, follow-up dates, closed items, and project-record filing.
